description: Order circuits by their share of all races and return exactly 10, cutting through any tie at 10th place arbitrarily.

d.request: Return the 10 circuits with the highest share of all races, where share is calculated as each circuit's race count divided by the total number of races globally, ordered by share descending with arbitrary tie-breaking at rank 10, displaying circuit ID, average round number, race count, and share value.
d.sql: SELECT c.circuitId, AVG(r.round) as avg_round, COUNT(r.raceId) as race_count, CAST(COUNT(r.raceId) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Order circuits by their share of all races (number of races at each circuit divided by total races), return the top 10 circuits (breaking ties at 10th position arbitrarily), and display circuit ID, average round of races, count of races, and share for each.
b.sql: SELECT c.circuitId, AVG(r.round) as avg_round, COUNT(r.raceId) as race_count, CAST(COUNT(r.raceId) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM circuits c JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
b.raw: Order circuits by their share of all races (number of races at each circuit divided by total races), return the top 10 circuits (breaking ties at 10th position arbitrarily), and display circuit ID, average round of races, count of races, and share for each.

c.request: What are the 10 circuits with the largest share of all races? For each, show the circuit Id (`races.circuitId`), the average `round` of its races, its number of races, and its share (its count divided by the total number of races across all circuits), largest share first. Order circuits by their share of all races and return exactly 10, cutting through any tie at 10th place arbitrarily.
c.sql: SELECT r.circuitId, AVG(r.round) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as num_races, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM races r GROUP BY r.circuitId ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

a.request: For each circuit (`races.circuitId`), give the average `round` of its races, its number of races, and its share of all races (its count divided by the total number of races across all circuits), sorted by share from highest to lowest, and return exactly the first 10 rows, picking arbitrarily among circuits tied at 10th place.
a.sql: SELECT circuitId, AVG(round) as avg_round, COUNT(*) as num_races, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) as share FROM races GROUP BY circuitId ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
